verdict.rationale: A public pricing page exists confirming a free/open-source tier and listing paid-tier features like data integrations and code indexing, but the evidence never shows concrete per-unit rates or usage-based pricing (e.g., cost per GB, per API call, per seat) that a platform engineer could use to project costs. Missing for 10: per-unit/usage-based rate tables, paid tier price points, and any cost calculator or unit economics beyond feature bullet points.
